+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M6GH30709S58BK3AQ1VMBAM7
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: Attribute permission, elicitation, file and terminal requests of a child to the child session id
+---
+## What
+RFD rule: an agent to client request made for a child carries the child session id and stays attributed to it. It does not move to the parent.
+
+Today `SubagentQuestionRelay` (FoundationModelsRouter) asks the question again in the parent session, and `ElicitationRelay` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/ElicitationRelay.swift`) sends it under the root session id. Change `ElicitationRelay` so that a relayed question whose origin is a child sends under the child id (the relay event keeps `elicitationId` and the agent path, so the origin is known). Do the same for permission requests (`AgentHooks.swift`, `ConfigOptions.swift` area where `session/request_permission` is sent) and for terminal create without `cwd`: it uses the effective `cwd` of the child.
+
+A cancel of the work answers the pending request `cancelled` (existing rule). A child that reports a cancelled `idle` lets the client clean up its pending requests.
+
+If the Router does not give the child origin on the relayed event, write the gap in the task comment and propose a card on FoundationModelsRouter. Do NOT change Router from this task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] An elicitation from a child run arrives at the client with the child `sessionId`.
+- [ ] A permission request from a child run arrives with the child `sessionId`; the same client policy applies as for the root.
+- [ ] `terminal/create` from a child without `cwd` uses the `cwd` of the child.
+- [ ] The answer of the client goes back down to the asking run.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/SubagentAttributionTests.swift`: elicitation, permission, terminal cwd, answer path, with a stub child run.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter SubagentAttributionTests`. All pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file
